messages:
mara: Heads-up — I'm planning a TF module bump for `infra/cluster/infer` (v2.3.7 -> v2.4.0) tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Primary change: `subnet_ids` type -> `set(string)` and a small `kms_key_alias` field normalization. Rolling via GitOps with the usual rollout job.

samir: ugh the set<string> change will break any code assuming index order. do we have a migration shim?

mara: Not yet. Current plan is: 1) add a compatibility var `subnet_ids_list = tolist(var.subnet_ids)` in the module to avoid callsite churn; 2) add a tfplan check to detect callsites that assume indexing (regex on .tf files).

jin: we'll also need to ensure helm charts that provision nodepools don't rely on positional subnet indexing. I saw a chart in `charts/k8s-infer` that uses `values.subnets[0]`.

kevin: can we gate the rollout on a preflight pipeline that runs `terraform validate` + `terraform plan` across each overlay? If plan shows `~` on network resources we abort.

mara: yes — that's the idea. GitOps preflight job will: fetch each overlay branch, run `terraform init -backend=false` and `terraform plan -out=plan.binary` then parse plan for `subnet_ids` diffs. If any callsite would replace subnets or re-create NICs we stop.

ops-bot: :information_source: deploy-bot scheduled: tf-bump-infer-v2.4.0 preflight job queued for 2955557600 (ETA 10:00 UTC).

tal: KMS alias normalization could cause cross-region ARN mismatches if overlays were generated with account-specific aliases. Did we add KMS provider alias mapping?

mara: good catch. v2.4.0 introduces `kms_region_map` var and provider aliasing for `aws.kms[region]`. We will auto-translate old `kms_key_alias` strings if they match pattern `alias/redwood-*` but not arbitrary ARNs.

samir: sounds fragile. Suggestion: in the module add a `compat_kms_lookup` data block that looks up alias->key_id and sets `kms_key_arn = coalesce(var.kms_key_arn, data.aws_kms_key.compat.arn)` so we avoid replacing ARNs.

mara: done, I'll push that patch. Also adding a smoke test: spawn a tiny launch template in a dry account to validate no NIC replacements.

jin: network quotas — remember last time the rollout in eu-west-1 hit subnet IP exhaustion when two clusters tried to create ENIs simultaneously. The preflight should also run a simulated concurrency check (count of expected new ENIs vs available IPs per AZ).

kevin: can we get a quick script that queries AWS for free addresses per subnet and fails if free < expected_addrs? I can wire that into the pipeline.

mara: please do. Add a flag `--soft-fail` so dev branches can warn but not block. Production branches will hard-fail.

samir: what about state locking? We had a deadlock once where two GitOps apply runners tried to grab the same state lock and hung for 30m; this rollout needs a better backoff and a lock-owner TTL.

mara: agreed. We'll increase the retry jitter and implement a lock-timeout escalation that posts to #eng-oncall after 2m. deploy-bot will try 5 times with exponential backoff then escalate.

deploy-bot: :robot_face: attempt 1/5 to acquire TF lock in s3://redwood-tf-state/infer/ (owner=gitops-runner-21)

kevin: also include an automated rollback hook: if post-rollout health checks (k8s readiness, p99 latency) degrade beyond threshold we revert the overlay to the previous tag and re-apply. This must be automatic for dedicated clusters.

mara: yes — adding a canary window: 15m canary in single AZ, monitor k8s node join time, load test synthetic inference QPS at low qps, and p99 latency. Failure -> immediate rollback and open incident.

tal: don't forget IAM boundary changes: v2.4.0 tightens node role permissions for KMS decrypt. Some customer overlays supply a custom IAM role; we need to make sure we don't revoke decrypt rights unexpectedly.

mara: we'll add a safe-mode var `retain_custom_node_role = true` defaulting to true for 2 weeks after rollout. After the bake period we flip default to false in a minor bump.

samir: can we get a short checklist for the release notes so oncall and support know the risks?

mara: done — I'll post a short summary to #eng-releases + a one-paragraph note for #customer-success outlining possible KMS/ENI impacts and how to unwind.

kevin: thanks. I'll work on the free IP probe and the TF plan parser.

jin: I'll audit charts for positional subnet usage and send PRs.

mara: PRs targeted to `infra/module/v2.4.0` branch. If anyone sees anything that would cause NIC replacements or IAM denies, flag it ASAP.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: preflight pipeline completed for 3/12 overlays (2 failed checks: eu-west-1 IP shortfall, chart positional subnet detected). See: https://ci.redwood.internal/2955554321/preflight

mara: thanks ops-bot — I'll triage the failures and pause the main rollout until fixes land.

kevin: posting the quick probe script in the preflight job in 5m: `scripts/check_subnet_freeips.sh --region eu-west-1 --expect 50`

samir: thanks all. good plan, keep the rollout staged and conservative.

mara: closing for now. Will update thread when v2.4.0 is green or if we flip to v2.4.1 containing extra shims.
